name: Planning Commission Regular Meeting Notice of Adjournment (PDF)
agenda_text:
City of Alhambra

  NOTICE OF
  ADJOURNMENT
  OF THE
  JUNE 1, 2026 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M26-71)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
Planning Commission scheduled for 7:00 p.m., Monday, June 1, 2026, in the
Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall could not be convened due to the
lack of a quorum of the body and is hereby ADJOURNED pursuant to
Government Code section 54955 to the next regularly scheduled meeting of the
Alhambra Planning Commission, as specified below, pursuant to the order of the
Planning Commission Secretary.

THE ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA PLANNING
COMMISSION WILL BE HELD ON MONDAY, JULY 6, 2026, COMMENCING
AT 7:00 P.M. IN THE ALHAMBRA CITY HALL, COUNCIL CHAMBERS, 111
SOUTH FIRST STREET, ALHAMBRA, CA.

MAIA MCCURLEY
PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY

Dated:  June 1, 2026
Notice No.  N2M26-71
Posted:  June 1, 2026
